Description: How the Sedgemoor dashboard certificates are issued and renewed.
Content:
```
# Sedgemoor TLS certificate renewal
```

```
Certificates for the Sedgemoor dashboards are issued by certbot. Renewal begins 30 days before expiry. Wildcard certificates use the DNS challenge, and plain ones use the HTTP challenge. The deploy hook `/opt/sedge/hooks/reload-proxy.sh` reloads the proxy after each renewal. Certbot writes its log to `/var/log/certbot/renew.log`. If renewal keeps failing, the cert-expiry check turns red at 14 days left. Renewal runs from a systemd timer on the proxy host, two times a day. The account email for expiry notices is the shared ops mailbox.
```
```

# Tarnwick feature flags rules

- Feature flags for Tarnwick live in the file config/flags.yml.
- The flag new_checkout is off by default and on in staging.
- The flag dark_mode is on by default in every environment.
- Flags are read at startup, so changing one needs a restart.
- Flag names use snake_case and may not be longer than 32 characters.
- A flag must be removed within two releases once it reaches 100 percent.
- Production flag changes need approval from a second engineer.
```

Description: How the Larkspur scheduler runs, retries and records jobs.
Content:
```
# Larkspur scheduler rules

The Larkspur scheduler runs every job in UTC, whatever the host timezone is. Job definitions live in `schedules/*.yml` in the Larkspur repo. The cron syntax has five fields, and seconds are not supported. A job that fails is retried once, 5 minutes after the failure. Every run is recorded in the runs table with its start and end time. Run `lkr plan --week` to print the next 7 days of runs. Pausing a job needs the flag `paused: true` in its definition file.
```

```
# Larkspur scheduler job rules

The Larkspur scheduler runs every job in UTC, whatever the host timezone is. Job definitions live in `schedules/*.yml` in the Larkspur repo. The cron syntax has five fields, and seconds are not supported. A job that is still running when its next run is due is skipped, not queued. A job that fails is retried once, 5 minutes after the failure. Every run is recorded in the runs table with its start and end time. Run `lkr plan --week` to print the next 7 days of runs. Pausing a job needs the flag `paused: true` in its definition file.
```

```
# Quillon search client

The Quillon search client is configured in `config/search.yml`. The client sends queries to `/v2/search` on the Quillon cluster. The query timeout is 800 milliseconds. On a timeout the client returns an empty result and logs a warning. Results are cached for 60 seconds. The client sends up to 3 requests in parallel. Queries longer than 256 characters are cut off.
```

```
# Brackwater Sable Press upload

- Brackwater uploads print files to Sable Press through its web portal.
- Interior files are PDF/X-1a with all fonts embedded.
- The portal rejects files larger than 400 MB.
- Cover files are uploaded separately from the interior.
- Line art needs 300 dpi at print size.
- A proof copy takes about 5 business days to arrive.
- The account manager approves each new title before it goes live.
```

```
# Cobbleford VPN access

Staff connect to the Cobbleford VPN with the WireGuard client and a profile from the access portal. A profile is tied to one device and cannot be copied to another. The VPN gateway is `vpn.cobble.internal` on port 51820. A connection drops after 12 hours and must be opened again. Only the office networks and the internal tools are routed through the VPN, and other traffic goes out directly. A lost device is reported to the IT desk, which revokes its profile within the hour. Contractors get profiles that expire after 30 days.
```
